Name: CS_DOF_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Depth of field settings for each level of the Depth of Field option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Depth of Field Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns depth of field on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Force High Resolution Blur
Fields.Description: Overrides the scene's high-resolution blur setting: -1 forces it off, 0 keeps the scene's setting, 1 forces it on. Retail: -1 up to Medium, 0 High, 1 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Maximum Blur Level
Fields.Description: Caps the blur quality level: 2 full quality, 1 one step lower, 0 lowest. A lower level set by the scene is kept. Retail: 0 Off and Low, 1 Medium, 2 High and Maximum.
